phase_owner: monotonic accepted displacement / 6, no cast reset, no sign reversal
mix: adjacent cardinal positive velocity components / L1 sum; same phase, shortest-arc quaternion hemisphere; never mix forward/back simultaneously
diagonal_limit: L1 skeletal blending reduces diagonal stride; require target-space re-solve/warping or report slip. No exact diagonal planting claim.
start_or_aim_change: Capture rendered lower world pose before changing aim root. Preserve it at first frame; lower-only 0.06-0.10 s transfer to same-phase new direction. Keep stance foot world anchor through IK. Reject transition if anchor is unreachable; do not stretch.

stop.capture: actual rendered lower WORLD pose, foot positions/orientations, phase, and lower yaw; simulation root stops immediately
stop.land: Do not reset pelvis yaw or blend both feet to idle. Hold support world anchor. Land airborne foot onto its own captured horizontal position, using bounded monotonic Z descent; keep old lower world yaw.
stop.landing_reach_guard: Before every descent, test target against actual hip and unstretched upper+lower chain. The observed .470/.267 m high, about +/- .62 m wide stop may not reach ground at current hip height. Lower only presentation pelvis within a feasible two-leg solution; otherwise keep the unlandable foot airborne and report the constraint. Never stretch, teleport, or silently drag the horizontal anchor.
stop.if_both_airborne: Use land_first hint but actual height/reach wins. Land one foot first, then the other. No simultaneous inward sweep.
stop.recover: After support exists, move ONE unweighted foot at a time to neutral in the captured lower frame, with <=.05 m clearance. Other foot remains world-anchored. Allow pelvis height to satisfy two-link reach.
stop.turn: Only after landing/recovery may idle facing change. If meaningful yaw remains, use stepped turn with one support anchor at a time, not two planted feet spinning.
stop.implementation_required: Runtime two-link IK or equivalent foot-lock target solve; metadata alone cannot fix stop. No baked stop clip is offered because arbitrary phase/root/aim makes it unsafe.

limits: No simulation position, speed, attack, cooldown, source-clock change
6 m/s and 0.6 s require crossover side running, not a shuffle
New clip authoring, Blender/GLB checks, runtime blend, normal-camera motion all remain separate gates
